CCM_ID='17568' (UPDATED) .
CCM_ID='17567' (DELETED) . 
CCM_ID='17571' (UNCHANGED) .
CCM_ID='9999' (NEW RECORD) . 

select CCM_ID CCM_ID2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT CCM_ID CCM_ID2, * FROM
EDS.ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING WHERE CCM_ID='17568'
UNION ALL
SELECT CCM_ID CCM_ID2, * FROM
EDS.ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING WHERE CCM_ID='17567'
UNION ALL
SELECT CCM_ID CCM_ID2, * FROM
EDS.ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING WHERE CCM_ID='17571'
UNION ALL
SELECT CCM_ID CCM_ID2, * FROM
EDS.ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING WHERE CCM_ID='9999' ) temp order by CCM_ID, SCD_START_DATE
